carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.desc: Notify Fabric disconnect listeners when Carpet fake players leave, removing stale BlueMap player markers.
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.extra.0: Notifies all Fabric disconnect subscribers once and ends the network session. Does not send extra JOIN events or require BlueMap.
carpet.rule.fixBlueMap.extra.1: Applies to subsequent disconnects, including currently online fake players. Does not repair already-stale BlueMap records or clean map item references.
carpet.rule.playerRetentionMemoryLeakFix: Release disconnected Carpet players from Fabric networking and remove stale player references from loaded maps.
Also cleans map references to removed ordinary players. Map cleanup runs every 100 server ticks.
Enabling protects subsequent disconnects, including currently online fake players. Network references leaked while disabled need a restart.
